targets.rawSql: SELECT check_timestamp AS time, feature_name, drift_score FROM drift_metrics WHERE model_id = 1 AND drift_detected = TRUE ORDER BY check_timestamp
SELECT created_at AS time, alert_type, severity, message FROM alerts WHERE acknowledged = FALSE ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT model_name, model_type, model_version, status, created_at FROM model_metadata ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT training_metrics->>'mape' AS mape FROM model_metadata WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT training_metrics->>'r2' AS r2 FROM model_metadata WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
